1	/-

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffCover
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.EffectivityPieces
8	
9	/-!
10	# Base change of sections on an ARBITRARY affine open (R2, human decision I-0492)
11	
12	The section-level input the widened base-change layer needs, in the `relCurve`/`relCurveMap`
13	spelling the divisor layer uses.
14	
15	## Why this file exists rather than reusing the chart-typed route
16	
17	`DivisorFamilyPullback.lean` reaches an affine piece **through its pinned chart**:
18	`relTermBaseChangeAlg` identifies `R' ⊗[R] Γ(C_R, V_R)` with `Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})` for `V` an
19	open of the BASE curve, and its proof is freeness-based (`relSectionsBaseChange`,
20	`R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ Γ(relCurve C R, V_R)`); `pieceTermBaseChangeAlg` then localizes at a
21	generator.  Neither step is available for an arbitrary affine open of `relCurve C R`: there
22	is no generator, and no presentation as a base-changed open of `C.left`.
23	
24	What replaces both is already in the tree, at exactly the right generality:
25	`Over.pieceRingEquiv` (`Picard/EffectivityPieces.lean`) gives
26	`Γ(U) ⊗[A] B ≃+* Γ(cg⁻¹ U)` for `U` an **arbitrary affine open**, from mathlib's affine
27	`pushoutSection` — no flatness, no freeness, `IsAffineOpen U` as the only hypothesis.  Its
28	`cg` is `relCurveMap` on the nose (`relCurveMap_eq_cg`).
29	
30	## Main declarations
31	
32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relCurveMap_eq_cg` — the two spellings of the curve comparison agree
33	  (`rfl`), which is what makes the effectivity keystone reusable here.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineOpen_relCurveMap_preimage` — the preimage of an affine open is
35	  affine.  The chart layer had to re-derive this as "a basic open of an affine chart".
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relAffSectionsMap` — the section comparison at an arbitrary open.
37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsBaseChangeAff` — `R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V) ≃ₐ[R']
38	  Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ V)` for an arbitrary affine open `V`, with
39	  `relSectionsBaseChangeAff_one_tmul` (`1 ⊗ s ↦ relAffSectionsMap s`) as the one computation
40	  rule everything downstream runs on.
41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relQuotBaseChangeAff` — the quotient transport
42	  `R' ⊗[R] (Γ(V) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(V') ⧸ (E')`, the widened colength transport, with
43	  `relQuotBaseChangeAff_one_tmul_mk`.
44	-/
45	
46	set_option autoImplicit false
47	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
48	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
49	
50	universe u
51	
52	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
53	open Opposite TensorProduct
54	
55	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
56	
57	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
58	
59	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
60	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
61	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
62	
63	/-- **The curve comparison of the divisor layer is the cover inclusion of the effectivity
64	layer.**  `relCurveMap` whiskers `overSpecMap R R'`, whose underlying morphism is
65	`Spec.map (algebraMap R R')`; `Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId R R').restrictScalars k)` is
66	the same `Over.homMk` of the same morphism. -/
67	lemma relCurveMap_eq_cg :
68	    relCurveMap C R R'
69	      = (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId R R').restrictScalars k)).left :=
70	  rfl
71	
72	/-- **The preimage of an affine open under the curve comparison is affine.**  `relCurveMap` is
73	the base change of the affine `Spec (algebraMap R R')` along the second projection, hence
74	affine (`Over.isAffineHom_cg`), and preimages of affine opens along an affine morphism are
75	affine. -/
76	theorem isAffineOpen_relCurveMap_preimage {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
77	    IsAffineOpen (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
78	  Over.isAffineOpen_cgPreimage (A := R) (B := R') C hV
79	
80	/-! ## The section comparison at an arbitrary affine open -/
81	
82	/-- **The section comparison** at an arbitrary open `V` of the relative curve: `appLE` of the
83	curve comparison from `V` to its preimage.  For `V` a base-changed chart this agrees with
84	`relSectionsMap`; unlike that map it needs no presentation of `V`. -/
85	noncomputable def relAffSectionsMap (V : (relCurve C R).Opens) :
86	    Γ(relCurve C R, V) →+* Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
87	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl).hom
88	
89	@[simp]
90	lemma relAffSectionsMap_apply (V : (relCurve C R).Opens) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
91	    relAffSectionsMap C R' V s
92	      = (relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s :=
93	  rfl
94	
95	/-! ## The section base change at an arbitrary affine open
96	
97	`Over.pieceRingEquiv` is stated on the `(C ⊗ overSpec k A).left` product spelling, with the
98	`Over.sectionsAlgebraA` algebra structure and the tensor factor on the RIGHT.  All three
99	differences from the divisor layer's conventions are `rfl`: the product spelling IS
100	`relCurve` (`relCurve` is a `def` for it), `Over.sectionsAlgebraA` IS
101	`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra` at the relative curve, and `cg` IS `relCurveMap`
102	(`relCurveMap_eq_cg`).  Only the tensor side needs an actual move, and that is
103	`Algebra.TensorProduct.comm`. -/
104	
105	/-- **Restriction naturality of the section comparison**: comparing then restricting is
106	restricting then comparing.  Holds for ARBITRARY opens `W ≤ V` — no affineness, because it is
107	only the two `appLE` collapse rules.  This is what identifies the base-changed overlap ideal
108	with the ideal of the base-changed equations. -/
109	lemma relAffSectionsMap_res {V W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
110	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
111	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.map (homOfLE ((relCurveMap C R R').preimage_mono h)).op).hom
112	        (relAffSectionsMap C R' V s)
113	      = relAffSectionsMap C R' W (((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s) := by
114	  have hle : relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V :=
115	    (relCurveMap C R R').preimage_mono h
116	  calc ((relCurve C R').presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom (relAffSectionsMap C R' V s)
117	      = ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
118	          (hle.trans le_rfl)).hom s := by
119	        rw [relAffSectionsMap_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
120	    _ = relAffSectionsMap C R' W (((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s) := by
121	        rw [relAffSectionsMap_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
122	
123	section BaseChange
124	
125	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebraA
126	
127	/-- **The raw section base change** at an arbitrary affine open, tensor factor on the right:
128	`Γ(V) ⊗[R] R' ≃+* Γ(relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ V)`.  This is `Over.pieceRingEquiv` read in the
129	`relCurve`/`relCurveMap` spelling — the identification is `rfl`, so this is a rename and not a
130	construction. -/
131	noncomputable def relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
132	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
133	    Γ(relCurve C R, V) ⊗[R] R' ≃+* Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
134	  Over.pieceRingEquiv (A := R) (B := R') C hV
135	
136	/-- On `s ⊗ 1` the raw base change is the section comparison `relAffSectionsMap`. -/
137	lemma relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv_tmul_one {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
138	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
139	    relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv C R' hV (s ⊗ₜ 1) = relAffSectionsMap C R' V s :=
140	  Over.pieceRingEquiv_tmul_one (A := R) (B := R') C hV s
141	
142	/-- On `1 ⊗ r'` the raw base change is the structure map of `Γ(V')` over `R'`. -/
143	lemma relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv_one_tmul {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
144	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (r' : R') :
145	    relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv C R' hV (1 ⊗ₜ r')
146	      = algebraMap R' Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) r' :=
147	  Over.pieceRingEquiv_one_tmul (A := R) (B := R') C hV r'
148	
149	/-- **The section base change at an arbitrary affine open, as an `R'`-algebra equivalence**
150	`R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ V)` — the widened
151	replacement for `relTermBaseChangeAlg ∘ pieceTermBaseChangeAlg`.  Assembled from
152	`Algebra.TensorProduct.comm` (to put the base-change factor on the left, the divisor layer's
153	convention) followed by the raw ring equivalence; `R'`-linearity is
154	`relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv_one_tmul`.
155	
156	No freeness, no localization, no generator: the only hypothesis is that `V` is affine. -/
157	noncomputable def relSectionsBaseChangeAff {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
158	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
159	  AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv
160	    (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V)).toRingEquiv.trans
161	      (relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv C R' hV))
162	    (fun r' => by
163	      change relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv C R' hV
164	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V) (r' ⊗ₜ 1)) = _
165	      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul, relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv_one_tmul])
166	
167	/-- **The computation rule** the whole widened layer runs on: `1 ⊗ s ↦ relAffSectionsMap s`. -/
168	@[simp]
169	lemma relSectionsBaseChangeAff_one_tmul {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
170	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
171	    relSectionsBaseChangeAff C R' hV ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) = relAffSectionsMap C R' V s := by
172	  change relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv C R' hV
173	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V) ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s)) = _
174	  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul, relSectionsBaseChangeAffRingEquiv_tmul_one]
175	
176	/-! ## The quotient transport (the widened colength transport) -/
177	
178	/-- The section base change carries the extended span of a set of equations to the span of
179	the compared equations — the `hIJ` input of the quotient transport. -/
180	lemma relSpanAff_map_eq {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
181	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
182	    Ideal.span (relAffSectionsMap C R' V '' E) =
183	      ((Ideal.span E).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := R')
184	        (B := Γ(relCurve C R, V)))).map
185	        (relSectionsBaseChangeAff C R' hV : _ →+* _) := by
186	  rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
187	  exact congrArg Ideal.span (Set.image_congr fun s _ =>
188	    (relSectionsBaseChangeAff_one_tmul C R' hV s).symm)
189	
190	/-- **Base change of a quotient of section rings at an arbitrary affine open** (the widened
191	colength transport): for a set `E` of equations on `V`,
192	`R' ⊗[R] (Γ(V) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(V') ⧸ (E')` with `V' = relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ V` and `E'` the image
193	of `E` under the section comparison.  Quotient right-exactness
194	(`Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv`) followed by transport along
195	`relSectionsBaseChangeAff`.
196	
197	At `E = {f}` this is the widened (c1) colength transport; at a two-element `E` it is the
198	overlap-colength transport — and, unlike the chart-typed layer, the two are the SAME
199	declaration at two opens, because an overlap of affine opens is again an affine open and needs
200	no re-presentation as a basic open of anything. -/
201	noncomputable def relQuotBaseChangeAff {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
202	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
203	    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, V) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']
204	      Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) ⧸
205	        Ideal.span (relAffSectionsMap C R' V '' E) :=
206	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv R' Γ(relCurve C R, V) R' (Ideal.span E)).trans
207	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ _ (relSectionsBaseChangeAff C R' hV)
208	      (relSpanAff_map_eq C R' hV E))
209	
210	/-- The quotient transport on a pure tensor of a residue class: `1 ⊗ [s] ↦ [s']`. -/
211	lemma relQuotBaseChangeAff_one_tmul_mk {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
212	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, V)) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
213	    relQuotBaseChangeAff C R' hV E ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
214	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (relAffSectionsMap C R' V '' E))
215	        (relAffSectionsMap C R' V s) := by
216	  have h1 : relQuotBaseChangeAff C R' hV E
217	      ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
218	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (relAffSectionsMap C R' V '' E))
219	        (relSectionsBaseChangeAff C R' hV ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s)) := rfl
220	  rw [h1, relSectionsBaseChangeAff_one_tmul]
221	
222	end BaseChange
223	
224	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffSections
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffAdaptation
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyMapAlg
9	
10	/-!
11	# Base change of the widened cover and adaptation (R2, human decision I-0492)
12	
13	`DivFamZarAff` (`DivisorFamilyAffZar.lean`) is a *type*, and until this file it was a type
14	with no functoriality: nothing base-changed a widened certified family along `R → R'`.  The
15	chart-typed value owns that layer (`DivisorFamilyMapAlg.lean`,
16	`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean`); this file and its successors give the widened one the same.
17	
18	## What the widening makes CHEAPER, not harder
19	
20	The base-changed cover is defined by **preimage**: `pieces j := relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ pieces j`.
21	Three consequences, each replacing a chart-typed detour:
22	
23	* `pieces_baseChange` is `rfl` (chart-side: `relSectionsMap_basicOpen`);
24	* the overlap identity is `Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf`, so the base-changed overlap IS the
25	  preimage of the overlap — the entire `ovlGen`/`basicOpen_ovlGen`/`isAffineOpen_chart_inf`
26	  apparatus, which existed only to re-present a piece overlap as a basic open of a chart
27	  overlap, has no analogue here;
28	* affineness of the base-changed pieces is `isAffineOpen_relCurveMap_preimage`, and the
29	  covering property is the preimage of a joint cover.  `FinCoverData.baseChange` had two
30	  partition-of-unity obligations to discharge; `AffCoverData.baseChange` has none, because the
31	  partitions are what R2 deleted.
32	
33	## Main declarations
34	
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffCoverData.baseChange` — the base-changed widened cover, with
36	  `pieces_baseChange` (`rfl`) and `inf_baseChange`.
37	* `AffAdaptation.pulledEqn`, `AffAdaptation.pullback` — the base-changed adaptation; `eqn_rel`
38	  transports through `Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE` exactly as `DivisorAdaptation.pullback` does.
39	* `AffAdaptation.eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`, `pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — section-level
40	  regularity of the equations, before and after base change.
41	-/
42	
43	set_option autoImplicit false
44	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
45	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
46	
47	universe u
48	
49	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
50	open Opposite TensorProduct
51	
52	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
53	
54	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
55	
56	/-- A ring isomorphism carries nonzerodivisors to nonzerodivisors (the `private` helper of
57	`Picard/DivisorFamilyPullbackMap.lean`, restated here because that one is file-private). -/
58	private lemma map_mem_nonZeroDivisors' {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
59	    (e : A ≃+* B) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) : e a ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by
60	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff] at ha ⊢
61	  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := ha
62	  refine ⟨fun b hb => ?_, fun b hb => ?_⟩
63	  · have h := congrArg e.symm hb
64	    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
65	    calc b = e (e.symm b) := (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
66	      _ = 0 := by rw [hl _ h, map_zero]
67	  · have h := congrArg e.symm hb
68	    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
69	    calc b = e (e.symm b) := (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
70	      _ = 0 := by rw [hr _ h, map_zero]
71	
72	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
73	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
74	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
75	
76	/-! ## The widened cover base change -/
77	
78	namespace AffCoverData
79	
80	variable (D : AffCoverData C R)
81	
82	/-- **Base change of the widened cover datum** along `R → R'`: take preimages.  Affineness is
83	`isAffineOpen_relCurveMap_preimage` (preimage of an affine open along the affine `relCurveMap`)
84	and the covering property is the preimage of the joint cover.  There is nothing else to
85	discharge — no generators, no partitions. -/
86	noncomputable def baseChange : AffCoverData C R' where
87	  m := D.m
88	  pieces j := relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j
89	  isAffineOpen j := isAffineOpen_relCurveMap_preimage C R' (D.isAffineOpen j)
90	  cover := by
91	    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => ?_
92	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := D.exists_mem_pieces ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)
93	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨j, hj⟩
94	
95	@[simp]
96	lemma baseChange_m : (D.baseChange R').m = D.m := rfl
97	
98	/-- **The pieces of the base-changed cover are the preimages of the pieces** — by definition,
99	so `rfl`.  Chart-side this needed `relSectionsMap_basicOpen`. -/
100	@[simp]
101	lemma pieces_baseChange (j : D.index) :
102	    (D.baseChange R').pieces j = relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j := rfl
103	
104	/-- The overlap of two base-changed pieces IS the preimage of the overlap.  This is the
105	identity that makes the chart-typed overlap apparatus unnecessary. -/
106	lemma inf_baseChange (i j : D.index) :
107	    (D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j
108	      = relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
109	  (Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf _).symm
110	
111	/-- The indexed piece comparison: `relAffSectionsMap` at the piece `j`.  Because the
112	base-changed piece IS the preimage, no `le` witness bookkeeping is needed. -/
113	noncomputable def piecesMap (j : D.index) :
114	    Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) →+* Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces j) :=
115	  relAffSectionsMap C R' (D.pieces j)
116	
117	/-- **The indexed piece-quotient transport**: `relQuotBaseChangeAff` at the piece `j`.  A
118	single declaration serves both the (c1) colength transport (`E` a singleton) and the overlap
119	transport (`E` a pair at the open `pieces i ⊓ pieces j`). -/
120	noncomputable def pieceQuotBaseChange (j : D.index) (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
121	    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']
122	      Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span (D.piecesMap R' j '' E) :=
123	  relQuotBaseChangeAff C R' (D.isAffineOpen j) E
124	
125	lemma pieceQuotBaseChange_one_tmul_mk (j : D.index)
126	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
127	    D.pieceQuotBaseChange R' j E ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
128	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (D.piecesMap R' j '' E)) (D.piecesMap R' j s) :=
129	  relQuotBaseChangeAff_one_tmul_mk C R' (D.isAffineOpen j) E s
130	
131	end AffCoverData
132	
133	/-! ## Section-level regularity of the widened equations -/
134	
135	namespace AffAdaptation
136	
137	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
138	variable (A : AffAdaptation D d)
139	
140	/-- **The equations are section-level regular**: their germs are nonzerodivisors
141	(`AffAdaptation.eqn_regular`) and sections of a sheaf inject into the product of their germs.
142	Verbatim the chart-typed `DivisorAdaptation.eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`; nothing about the piece
143	is used but that it is an open. -/
144	theorem eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (j : D.index) :
145	    A.eqn j ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) := by
146	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
147	  intro t ht
148	  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext (relCurve C R).sheaf (D.pieces j) t 0
149	  intro z hz
150	  rw [map_zero]
151	  have key : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) z hz).hom t
152	      * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) z hz).hom (A.eqn j) = 0 := by
153	    rw [← map_mul, ht, map_zero]
154	  exact (mul_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff (A.eqn_regular j z hz)).mp
155	    (by rw [mul_comm] at key; exact key)
156	
157	/-- The pulled equation on the base-changed piece. -/
158	noncomputable def pulledEqn (j : D.index) :
159	    Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces j) :=
160	  D.piecesMap R' j (A.eqn j)
161	
162	/-- **The pulled equations are section-level regular** (Kleiman `lm:ctn` (i)⟹(iii), made
163	cheap, with no hypothesis on `R'`): the colength is projective hence flat over `R`, so the
164	equation stays regular in `R' ⊗[R] Γ(pieces j) ≅ Γ(pieces' j)`.  The transport is now the
165	widened `relSectionsBaseChangeAff` rather than the chart-typed term identification; the
166	flatness input `includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker` is unchanged, being a statement
167	about a bare commutative `R`-algebra. -/
168	theorem pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
169	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) (j : D.index) :
170	    A.pulledEqn R' j ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces j) := by
171	  haveI := hproj j
172	  have hreg := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker
173	    (R := R) R' (A.eqn j) (A.eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors j)
174	  have h2 := map_mem_nonZeroDivisors'
175	    (relSectionsBaseChangeAff C R' (D.isAffineOpen j)).toRingEquiv hreg
176	  have h1 : (relSectionsBaseChangeAff C R' (D.isAffineOpen j)).toRingEquiv
177	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A.eqn j)) = A.pulledEqn R' j := by
178	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
179	    exact relSectionsBaseChangeAff_one_tmul C R' (D.isAffineOpen j) (A.eqn j)
180	  rwa [h1] at h2
181	
182	/-- **The `hreg` discharge, widened**: germs of the pulled equations of `d` are
183	nonzerodivisors at every point of the pulled cover members.  Every point lies in a
184	base-changed piece (`AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`, one line from the joint-cover field
185	where the chart version needed `relCover_sup` plus two partitions); there the pulled equation
186	differs from the pulled piece equation, regular by `pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` and the
187	affine germ seam, by a stalk unit assembled from the adaptation unit `eqn_rel`. -/
188	theorem germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
189	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j))
190	    (y z : relCurve C R')
191	    (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
192	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
193	        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) z hz).hom
194	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
195	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
196	  obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := (D.baseChange R').exists_mem_pieces z
197	  have hzj' : z ∈ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j := hzj
198	  have hfzj : (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈ D.pieces j := hzj'
199	  have hfzy : (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y) := hz
200	  have hfzW : (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈
201	      D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y) :=
202	    ⟨hfzj, hfzy⟩
203	  -- the regular germ of the pulled piece equation
204	  have hF : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom
205	      (A.pulledEqn R' j) ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) :=
206	    IsAffineOpen.germ_mem_nonZeroDivisors ((D.baseChange R').isAffineOpen_pieces j)
207	      (A.pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' hproj j) z hzj
208	  -- germ of the pulled piece equation = stalk image of the germ of the piece equation
209	  have hgermF : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom
210	      (A.pulledEqn R' j) =
211	      ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
212	        (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j)
213	          ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzj).hom (A.eqn j)) := by
214	    have happ := (relCurveMap C R R').germ_stalkMap_apply (D.pieces j) z hfzj (A.eqn j)
215	    have hres : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom
216	        (A.pulledEqn R' j) =
217	        ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j) z hzj').hom
218	          (((relCurveMap C R R').app (D.pieces j)).hom (A.eqn j)) := by
219	      have hstep := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (relCurve C R').presheaf
220	        (homOfLE (le_refl (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j))) z hzj
221	        (((relCurveMap C R R').app (D.pieces j)).hom (A.eqn j))
222	      rw [← hstep]
223	      rfl
224	    rw [hres, happ]
225	  -- decompose through the pointwise unit clause at the base point of `y`
226	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := A.eqn_rel j ((relCurveMap C R R').base y)
227	  have hdecomp : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j)
228	      ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzj).hom (A.eqn j) =
229	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
230	          (D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
231	          ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzW).hom
232	        (u : Γ(relCurve C R,
233	          D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))) *
234	        ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
235	          ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzy).hom
236	          (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y)) := by
237	    have hkey := congrArg ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
238	        (D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
239	        ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzW).hom hu
240	    rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at hkey
241	    exact hkey
242	  -- the goal germ is the stalk image of the germ of `d.eqn (f.base y)`
243	  have hgermG : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
244	      ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) z hz).hom
245	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y) =
246	      ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
247	        (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
248	          ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzy).hom
249	          (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))) := by
250	    rw [Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn]
251	    have happLE : ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE
252	        (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
253	        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) le_rfl).hom
254	        (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y)) =
255	        ((relCurve C R').presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl
256	          ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y))).op).hom
257	          (((relCurveMap C R R').app
258	            (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))).hom
259	            (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))) := rfl
260	    rw [happLE, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
261	    exact ((relCurveMap C R R').germ_stalkMap_apply
262	      (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y)) z hfzy
263	      (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))).symm
264	  -- assemble
265	  have hunit : IsUnit (((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
266	      (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
267	        (D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
268	        ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzW).hom
269	        (u : Γ(relCurve C R,
270	          D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))))) :=
271	    (u.isUnit.map ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
272	      (D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
273	      ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzW).hom).map
274	      ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
275	  have hkey : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom
276	      (A.pulledEqn R' j) =
277	      (hunit.unit : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z)ˣ) *
278	        (((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
279	          (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
280	            ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzy).hom
281	            (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y)))) := by
282	    rw [hgermF, hdecomp, map_mul, IsUnit.unit_spec]
283	  rw [hgermG]
284	  have hSM : ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
285	      (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
286	        ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzy).hom
287	        (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))) =
288	      ↑hunit.unit⁻¹ *
289	        ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom
290	          (A.pulledEqn R' j) := by
291	    rw [hkey, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
292	  rw [hSM]
293	  exact mul_mem hunit.unit⁻¹.isUnit.mem_nonZeroDivisors hF
294	
295	/-- **The pulled local-equation system**, widened: `d` pulls back along the relative-curve
296	comparison, with regularity discharged by the certificate's colength projectivity. -/
297	noncomputable def pulledEquations (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
298	    (relCurve C R').LocalEquations :=
299	  d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') (A.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' hproj)
300	
301	@[simp]
302	lemma pulledEquations_cover (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
303	    (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover = d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') :=
304	  rfl
305	
306	/-- The Picard class of the pulled system is the pullback of the class of `d`. -/
307	lemma picClass_pulledEquations (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
308	    (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).picClass =
309	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R R') d.picClass :=
310	  Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') d _
311	
312	/-! ## The base-changed adaptation -/
313	
314	/-- **The base-changed widened adaptation**: the base-changed cover carrying the pulled
315	equations.  The pointwise refinement clause `eqn_rel` transports clause for clause exactly as
316	in `DivisorAdaptation.pullback` — the target overlap is the `relCurveMap`-preimage of the
317	source overlap and the source clause pulls through `Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE`.  Nothing in that
318	argument mentions a chart; here it is even shorter, because the piece inclusion

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffBaseChange
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyPullbackGlued
8	
9	/-!
10	# Certified base change on the widened cover (R2, human decision I-0492)
11	
12	The seven certificate clauses of `AffAdaptation.IsCertified` transport along an arbitrary test
13	change `R → R'`.  This is the last structural piece the widened value needed: without it
14	`DivFamZarAff` is a type with no functoriality, and nothing downstream can base-change a
15	widened class.
16	
17	## Two definitional identities do most of the work
18	
19	Both were probed and hold on the nose, which is why this file is short:
20	
21	* the base-changed overlap **is** the preimage of the overlap
22	  (`(D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j = relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ (pieces i ⊓
23	  pieces j)` by `rfl`, since `⁻¹ᵁ` commutes with `⊓` definitionally on `Opens`);
24	* the pulled colength **is** the quotient `relQuotBaseChangeAff` lands in.
25	
26	So the widened colength and overlap transports are the SAME declaration
27	(`AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange`) at two different opens, where the chart-typed layer
28	needed `pieceQuotBaseChange` and a separately-constructed `ovlQuotBaseChange` conjugated
29	through the overlap generator.
30	
31	## What is reused verbatim
32	
33	Clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) ride the abstract `FlatCokernel` keystones
34	(`LinearMap.ker_lTensor_eq_of_flat_coker`, `LinearMap.tensorKerEquivOfFlatCoker`,
35	`LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv`) and the two square-transport lemmas
36	(`LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq`, `LinearEquiv.range_eq_map_range_of_comp_eq`).  All are
37	stated for bare modules and know nothing about covers, so the widening does not touch them.
38	
39	## Main declarations
40	
41	* `AffAdaptation.colengthBaseChange`, `ovlColengthBaseChange` — the (c1) and overlap
42	  transports, both `AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange`.
43	* `AffAdaptation.chartProdBaseChange`, `ovlProdBaseChange` — the product transports.
44	* `AffAdaptation.delta_baseChange_comm` — `δ`-naturality, a `funext` over the pair index.
45	* `AffAdaptation.gluedBaseChange` and the (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transports.
46	* `AffAdaptation.isCertified_pullback` — **the certificate base-changes**, all seven clauses.
47	-/
48

50	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
51	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
52	
53	universe u
54	
55	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
56	open Opposite TensorProduct
57	
58	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
59	
60	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
61	
62	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
63	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
64	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
65	
66	namespace AffAdaptation
67	
68	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
69	variable (A : AffAdaptation D d) (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j))
70	
71	/-! ## The colength transports (clause (c1)) -/
72	
73	/-- **Base change of a piece colength**: `R' ⊗[R] colength j ≃ₐ[R'] (pullback).colength j`.
74	This is `AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange` at the singleton `{eqn j}`; the target is
75	definitionally the pulled colength. -/
76	noncomputable def colengthBaseChange (j : D.index) :
77	    R' ⊗[R] A.colength j ≃ₐ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).colength j :=
78	  (D.pieceQuotBaseChange R' j {A.eqn j}).trans
79	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R' (by rw [Set.image_singleton]; rfl))
80	
81	/-- (c1) transport, finiteness. -/
82	theorem finite_colength_pullback (hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)) (j : D.index) :
83	    Module.Finite R' ((A.pullback R' hproj).colength j) := by
84	  haveI := hfin j
85	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j).toLinearEquiv
86	
87	/-- (c1) transport, projectivity. -/
88	theorem projective_colength_pullback (j : D.index) :
89	    Module.Projective R' ((A.pullback R' hproj).colength j) := by
90	  haveI := hproj j
91	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j).toLinearEquiv

93	/-- **Base change of an overlap colength**.  The SAME declaration as the piece transport, at
94	the open `pieces i ⊓ pieces j` — no overlap generator, no conjugation.  Requires the overlap
95	to be affine, which is a hypothesis rather than a field: `AffCoverData` demands affineness of
96	the pieces only, and overlaps are affine when the relative curve is separated. -/
97	noncomputable def ovlColengthBaseChange
98	    (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) (i j : D.index) :
99	    R' ⊗[R] A.ovlColength i j ≃ₐ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlColength i j :=
100	  (relQuotBaseChangeAff C R' (hinf i j)
101	      {relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) (A.eqn i),
102	       relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) (A.eqn j)}).trans
103	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R' (by
104	      rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
105	      exact congrArg₂ (fun x y => Ideal.span {x, y})
106	        (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
107	          (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) (A.eqn i)).symm
108	        (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
109	          (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) (A.eqn j)).symm))
110

187	lemma pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange (i j : D.index) (x : R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) :
188	    (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft i j (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj i x) =
189	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf i j
190	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap) x) := by
191	  induction x with
192	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
193	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
194	  | tmul r' y =>
195	    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
196	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t) :
197	        R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) =
198	        r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) := by
199	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
200	    rw [hsmul]
201	    simp only [map_smul]
202	    congr 1
203	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap)
204	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) =
205	        (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) :=
206	      rfl
207	    rw [A.colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj i t, hlt, A.toOvlLeft_mk' i j t,
208	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj hinf i j _,
209	      (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft_mk' i j _]
210	    exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)
211	      (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
212	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) t)

217	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight i j).toLinearMap) x) := by

243	/-- **`δ`-naturality**: the pulled difference arrow matches `id ⊗ δ` through the product
244	transports.  A `funext` over the pair index feeding the two squares above — index-shape
245	agnostic, so the widening costs nothing here. -/
246	theorem delta_baseChange_comm :
247	    ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight) ∘ₗ
248	        (A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj :
249	          R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd →ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd) =
250	      (A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf :
251	          R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd →ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd) ∘ₗ
252	        AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) := by
253	  apply LinearMap.ext
254	  intro x
255	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
256	  induction x with
257	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
258	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
259	  | tmul r' s =>
260	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) = r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) := by
261	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
262	    rw [hsmul]
263	    simp only [map_smul]
264	    congr 1
265	    funext p
266	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
267	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s) := rfl
268	    have hcomp : (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s =
269	        fun p : D.index × D.index =>
270	          A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1) - A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
271	      funext q
272	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, deltaLeft, deltaRight, LinearMap.pi_apply,
273	        LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
274	        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
275	    have hL : (((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight)
276	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj) ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
277	        (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft p.1 p.2
278	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj p.1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1)) -
279	          (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlRight p.1 p.2
280	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2)) := by
281	      have h1 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj 1 s p.1
282	      have h2 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj 1 s p.2
283	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, deltaLeft, deltaRight,
284	        LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
285	        LinearMap.proj_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, h1, h2]
286	    have hR : ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf)
287	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
288	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
289	        A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2
290	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1))) -
291	          A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2
292	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2))) := by
293	      rw [hlt, A.ovlProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj hinf 1 _ p, hcomp,
294	        TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub]
295	    have hltL : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2).toLinearMap)
296	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1)) := rfl
297	    have hltR : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2).toLinearMap)
298	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2)) := rfl
299	    rw [hL, hR,
300	      A.pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1),
301	      A.pulledToOvlRight_colengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2),
302	      hltL, hltR]

Continued the R2 widening lane (human decision I-0492). The predecessor session built the widened `DivFamZarAff` but left it as an **island** — nothing mapped into it, so every chart-typed certificate the tree already owned was formally unreachable from the widened predicate. This session closed that, then discharged the cert-collapse leaf. Two commits, two new files, both sorry-free; root build green at 9149 jobs.

## Progress
- `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`: new, 282L, 0 sorries — `DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_toAff` migrates a chart-typed certificate to the widened cover, **all seven clauses**, giving `isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified`, `DivFamZar.toAff`, and `picClass_toAff` (the Picard class is unchanged, so DAT-C reads the same class from either value). (c1) is `rfl` at the relabelled index; the glued clauses go along `piCongrLeft.symm`.

Includes `ovlColengthDiagEquiv`, the node's "one technical lemma still needed".
- `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffZar.lean`: three stale docstring claims corrected — it advertised three declarations of which **none existed**; two now do, and the third (`IsFibrewiseFiniteSupport`) never did, so obligation I-0492 4(i) is repointed at where it genuinely lives.

The objective is substantively complete and now independently verified, so I did **not** leave the task open for lack of review as the predecessor did. 11	/-!
12	# The widened divisor-functor map (R2, human decision I-0492)
13	
14	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` along an arbitrary test change `R → R'`, with the functor laws, the Abel
15	hook, and the Zariski separation keystone.  This is what makes the widened value a functor
16	VALUE rather than a bare type: before this file nothing could base-change a widened class.
17	
18	## Where the widening does and does not show
19	
20	Almost nowhere.  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` widens where the pieces live on the CURVE and changes
21	nothing about the Zariski cover of the BASE, so the base-side machinery of
22	`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean` — the `Localization.Away` towers, `IsLocalization.map`,
23	`span_range_algebraMap_eq_top` — applies verbatim; the cover datum only appears inside the
24	opaque `mapAlg` of the local certified family.  Likewise
25	`Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback`, `divEq_pullback_id` and `divEq_pullback_pullback` are
26	stated for ARBITRARY scheme morphisms and know nothing about covers, so the functor laws are
27	the same three lines as in the chart-typed case.
28	
29	## The one honest cost of the widening: overlap affineness
30	
31	`AffCoverData` demands affineness of the pieces only (that is the R2 shape), so the certificate
32	transport takes an explicit `hinf` — the overlaps are affine.  A `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`
33	therefore cannot be base-changed without it, and rather than weaken the structure this file
34	carries `hinf` as a hypothesis on `mapAlg` at the family level.  It is not a hidden
35	assumption: it is visible in every signature below, as I-0492 clause 4 requires.  For a
36	relative curve over a proper `C` it is discharged by separatedness (`IsAffineOpen.inf`).
37	
38	## Main declarations
39	
40	* `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg` — base change of a widened certified family.
41	* `IsLocallyCertifiedAff.pullback` — certificate transport along an arbitrary test change.
42	* `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg`, with `mapAlg_mk`, `picClass_mapAlg`, `mapAlg_id`, `mapAlg_comp`.
43	* `DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq` — Zariski separation at the widened Zar level.
44	-/

51

53	open Opposite TensorProduct

57	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

59	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
60	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]

65	def AffCoverData.HasAffineOverlaps (D : AffCoverData C R) : Prop :=
66	  ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)

257	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is a finite `R`-module. -/
258	  finite_glued : Module.Finite R A.Glued
259	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is projective over `R`. -/
260	  projective_glued : Module.Projective R A.Glued
261	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module has constant fibre rank `n`. -/
262	  rankAtStalk_glued : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk A.Glued p = n

266	  flat_coker_diff :

Fresh-context audit of the eight/ten DivisorFamilyAff*.lean files (I-0521 checks). All three named checks come back CLEAN — see the separate memory item. This is the one real gap, and it is a throughput gap, not an error.

WHAT IS TRUE. IsLocallyCertifiedAff is inhabited from exactly two directions:
 (a) isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified (DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean:249) — via the chart-typed pin, so it produces nothing the fixed-pair design could not already produce;
 (b) the hypothesis-shaped gates isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_exists_away (Zar:206) and isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation (Assemble:117), which take a CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff / (AffCoverData, AffAdaptation, IsCertified) at every prime and repackage it.

WHAT IS MISSING. Nothing constructs an AffAdaptation over a cover with a straddling piece for an actual divisor. Compare the chart-typed side, which has BOTH an extraction (exists_divisorAdaptation, DivisorFamilyExtraction.lean:54) AND a field-case certificate (DivisorFamilyFieldSurj.isCertified_of_deg:104, all seven clauses from a degree hypothesis). The widened side has neither: no exists_affAdaptation, no isCertifiedAff_of_deg, no AffAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor. So the strictly-larger predicate is, at HEAD, only as populated as the strictly-smaller one — the widening is structurally complete and mathematically unexercised.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE R2 CLAIM. The R2 payoff is 'a straddling divisor has an affine-open certificate though it has no chart-typed one'. No landed declaration exhibits that. AffCoverData.ofSwallowingPiece (Swallow.lean:140) assembles the cover but takes W and its affineness as inputs; SwallowedBy is a separate hypothesis; and nothing produces either from a divisor. The honest state is: the widened TARGET exists and receives the old material; the widening has not yet certified anything new.

CONCRETE NEXT STEP, in order of value: (1) an affine-open analogue of exists_divisorAdaptation over ofSwallowingPiece; (2) the widened field case (AffAdaptation over a field: every module free, so six of seven clauses are instances and only the rank needs deg_presentationDivisor, which is currently stated only for DivisorAdaptation); (3) then a divisor-level producer of W and SwallowedBy, or an explicit statement that 0B8B stays an axiom-free hypothesis of the lane.

namespace AffCoverData

/-- **The widened cover from a straddling affine open plus a cover of the rest.** `W` is the
affine open containing the support (the Stacks `0B8B` piece); `Ws` is any finite family of
affine opens which, together with `W`, covers the curve.  The straddling condition itself is
`SwallowedBy` and is a separate hypothesis — this constructor only assembles the cover. -/
noncomputable def ofSwallowingPiece (W : (relCurve C R).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    {m : ℕ} (Ws : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens) (hWs : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (Ws i))
    (hcover : W ⊔ (⨆ i, Ws i) = ⊤) :
    AffCoverData C R where
  m := m + 1
  pieces := Fin.snoc Ws W
  isAffineOpen := fun j => by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hW
    · intro i; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hWs i
  cover := by
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => ?_
    have hz : z ∈ W ⊔ (⨆ i, Ws i) := by rw [hcover]; trivial
    rcases (Opens.mem_sup ..).mp hz with hzW | hzWs
    · exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨Fin.last m, by rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hzW⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hzWs
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i.castSucc, by rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hi⟩

end AffCoverData

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamily
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Separatedness
8	
9	/-!
10	# The widened cover datum: arbitrary affine opens (R2, human decision I-0492)
11	
12	`FinCoverData` (`Picard/DivisorFamily.lean`) types its pieces INTO a fixed pair of pinned
13	`P¹` charts — `h₀ : Fin m₀ → Γ(V₀)`, `h₁ : Fin m₁ → Γ(V₁)`, `pieces = Sum.elim (basicOpen ∘
14	h₀) (basicOpen ∘ h₁)` — with a partition of unity on EACH chart.  Per-piece swallow-or-miss
15	needs only openness (`DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean`), and it is the chart-wise partitions that
16	upgrade "inside one piece" to "inside one chart"; that upgrade is the obstruction, and no
17	repair keeping the pieces inside the preimages of a fixed pair of points of `P¹` can work
18	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2, ADDENDUM 4 §4.4).
19	
20	This file carries the widened datum.  A piece is an **arbitrary affine open** of the
21	relative curve, the index is a bare `Fin m`, and the covering condition is **joint**
22	(`⨆ j, pieces j = ⊤`) rather than chart-wise.  Nothing types a piece into a chart.
23	
24	Justification for the shape, used and not re-derived (I-0492 clause 2): `supp D` is finite
25	over `R`, hence lies in a single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`), so a cover
26	with one straddling piece always exists.
27	
28	## What the widening RELOCATES rather than removes (I-0492 clause 4(ii))
29	
30	The old typing was silently supplying two things that now have to be earned:
31	
32	* **every point lies in a piece** — was `relCover_sup` plus the two partitions; now it is
33	  exactly the joint covering field (`AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`);
34	* **`Γ(pieces j)` is `R`-flat** — was `flat_sections_basicOpen` over
35	  `flat_sections_relPinnedChart`, i.e. it rested on `Γ(V_bᴿ) ≅ R ⊗[k] Γ(C, V_b)` being FREE.
36	  For an arbitrary affine open that route is gone.  Replacement, and it is the one genuinely
37	  new commutative-algebra input the widening costs: `relCurve C R ↘ Spec R` is flat (it is
38	  the base change of `C.hom` along `overSpec k R`, and a morphism to a field spectrum is
39	  flat), and a flat morphism has `R`-flat sections on every affine open
40	  (`flat_sections_of_flat_hom`).  Unconditional in `R` — no Noetherian, no finiteness.
41	
42	Fibrewise-finite support (I-0492 clause 4(i)) is deliberately NOT here: it is not a property
43	of a cover, it must come from the seed's own degree data, and it may not hide inside a
44	`LocalEquations` or an adaptation field.
45	
46	## Main declarations
47	
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.flat_sections_of_flat_hom` — sections of an arbitrary affine open of a
49	  scheme flat over the base ring are flat.
50	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instFlatRelCurveHom` — the relative curve is flat over its test base.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffCoverData` — the widened cover datum.
52	* `AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`, `isAffineOpen_pieces`, `flat_sections_pieces`,
53	  `flat_sections_pieces_inf` — the derived replacements for what the chart typing supplied.
54	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` — the migration: old data instantiates the
55	  widened datum, so nothing landed becomes unreachable.
56	-/
57	
58	set_option autoImplicit false
59	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
60	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
61	
62	universe u
63	
64	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
65	
66	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
67	
68	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
69	
70	/-! ## Flat sections on an arbitrary affine open
71	
72	The engine that replaces the pinned-chart freeness argument. -/
73	
74	section FlatSections
75	
76	variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of K))]
77	
78	/-- **Sections of an arbitrary affine open are flat, for a scheme flat over the base ring.**
79	`Scheme.overAlgebraMap` factors as `ΓSpecIso.inv` followed by the structure morphism's
80	`appLE ⊤ V`; the second is `RingHom.Flat` because `AlgebraicGeometry.Flat` is a
81	`HasRingHomProperty` for `RingHom.Flat` and `V` is affine, the first is flat because it is a
82	ring isomorphism, and `RingHom.Flat` composes.
83	
84	This is the widened replacement for `flat_sections_basicOpen ∘ flat_sections_relPinnedChart`:
85	that pair needed the open to be a basic open of a chart whose sections are a FREE base
86	change, which is exactly what an arbitrary affine open does not give. -/
87	theorem flat_sections_of_flat_hom [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
88	    {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
89	    Module.Flat K Γ(X, V) := by
90	  have happ : RingHom.Flat ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom :=
91	    HasRingHomProperty.appLE (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Flat)
92	      (f := X ↘ Spec (.of K)) inferInstance ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩ (by simp)
93	  have hiso : RingHom.Flat ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom :=
94	    RingHom.Flat.of_bijective
95	      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv)
96	  have hcomp : RingHom.Flat (X.overAlgebraMap K V) := by
97	    have hfac : X.overAlgebraMap K V
98	        = ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom.comp
99	            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom := by
100	      rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, Scheme.Hom.appLE]
101	      rfl
102	    rw [hfac]
103	    exact RingHom.Flat.comp hiso happ
104	  exact (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff (R := K) (S := Γ(X, V))).mp hcomp
105	
106	end FlatSections
107	
108	section RelCurveFlat
109	
110	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
111	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
112	
113	/-- **The relative curve is flat over its test base.** `(snd C (overSpec k R)).left` is the
114	base change of `C.hom` along `(overSpec k R).hom` (`Over.isPullback_left`), and every
115	structure morphism to the spectrum of a field is flat (`flat_hom_over_field`). -/
116	instance instFlatRelCurveHom : AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (relCurve C R ↘ Spec (.of R)) :=
117	  AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.isStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
118	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k R)) inferInstance
119	
120	/-- **Flat sections on an arbitrary affine open of the relative curve** — the widened
121	(c1)-flatness input, with no chart and no freeness. -/
122	theorem flat_sections_isAffineOpen {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
123	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, V) :=
124	  flat_sections_of_flat_hom R (relCurve C R) hV
125	
126	end RelCurveFlat
127	
128	/-! ## The widened cover datum -/
129	
130	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
131	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
132	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)
133	
134	/-- **The widened cover datum** (R2, human decision I-0492): finitely many **arbitrary
135	affine opens** of the relative curve that **jointly** cover it.
136	
137	Contrast with `FinCoverData`, which this replaces on the certificate side: there is no `h₀`,
138	no `h₁`, no `a₀`/`a₁`, no `partition₀`/`partition₁`, no `Sum` index, and above all no typing
139	of a piece into a pinned chart.  The chart-wise partitions of unity are exactly what upgraded
140	per-piece swallow-or-miss to a chart statement, and they are gone deliberately; the two-chart
141	structure the Θ-layer needs is carried separately (see `ChartTyping` below), never by the
142	certificate clauses.
143	
144	`Type u`, like `FinCoverData`, so a functor value can quotient it. -/
145	structure AffCoverData : Type u where
146	  /-- The number of pieces. -/
147	  m : ℕ
148	  /-- The pieces: arbitrary opens of the relative curve, made affine by `isAffineOpen`. -/
149	  pieces : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens
150	  /-- Every piece is affine — the only geometric demand the certificate layer makes. -/
151	  isAffineOpen : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (pieces j)
152	  /-- The pieces cover the curve JOINTLY.  This replaces the two chart-wise partitions of
153	  unity, and it is the whole structural content of the widening. -/
154	  cover : (⨆ j, pieces j) = ⊤
155	
156	namespace AffCoverData
157	
158	variable {C R π} (D : AffCoverData C R)
159	
160	/-- The gluing index of the widened datum: a bare `Fin`, with no two-sided structure. -/
161	abbrev index : Type := Fin D.m
162	
163	/-- **Every point lies in a piece.** Under `FinCoverData` this came from `relCover_sup`
164	together with the two partitions of unity; here it is exactly the joint covering field —
165	obligation I-0492 4(ii) discharged in one line rather than silently supplied by the typing. -/
166	lemma exists_mem_pieces (z : relCurve C R) : ∃ j : D.index, z ∈ D.pieces j := by
167	  have hz : z ∈ (⨆ j, D.pieces j) := by rw [D.cover]; trivial
168	  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mp hz
169	
170	/-- The pieces are affine opens — by fiat now, rather than as basic opens of an affine
171	chart. -/
172	lemma isAffineOpen_pieces (j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces j) :=
173	  D.isAffineOpen j
174	
175	/-- **Flatness of the piece section rings over the test ring.** The widened replacement for
176	`FinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces`, which localized a FREE pinned-chart ring; here it is the
177	flat structure morphism of the relative curve read on an affine open. -/
178	theorem flat_sections_pieces (j : D.index) :
179	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) :=
180	  flat_sections_isAffineOpen C R (D.isAffineOpen j)
181	
182	/-- Piece overlaps are affine (the relative curve is separated over `Spec R`, being proper),
183	so the overlap section rings are flat too — the widened
184	`FinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces_inf`. -/
185	theorem flat_sections_pieces_inf (i j : D.index)
186	    (hinf : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
187	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
188	  flat_sections_isAffineOpen C R hinf
189	
190	end AffCoverData
191	
192	/-! ## The optional chart typing, for the Θ-layer only -/
193	
194	/-- The pinned chart of a given side, spelled here so this file needs no import from the
195	Θ-layer (it agrees with `relPinnedChart` by `rfl`). -/
196	noncomputable def pinnedChartOfSide [IsAffineHom π] (b : Bool) : (relCurve C R).Opens :=
197	  bif b then (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ else (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
198	
199	/-- **A chart typing of a widened cover**: an assignment of each piece to one of the two
200	pinned `P¹` charts, containing it.  This is what the Θ-twisting unit genuinely needs (the
201	theta cocycle lives on `V₀ ⊓ V₁`), and it is deliberately a SEPARATE datum: no certificate
202	clause and no locally-certified predicate may require it.  Keeping it separate is what stops
203	the old fixed-pair typing from being smuggled back in through a field. -/
204	structure ChartTyping [IsAffineHom π] (D : AffCoverData C R) where
205	  /-- Which pinned chart the piece is assigned to. -/
206	  side : D.index → Bool
207	  /-- The piece is contained in its assigned chart. -/
208	  piece_le : ∀ j, D.pieces j ≤ pinnedChartOfSide C R π (side j)
209	
210	/-! ## Migration: old cover data instantiates the widened datum -/
211	
212	namespace FinCoverData
213	
214	variable {C R π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : FinCoverData C R π)
215	
216	/-- **The migration map.** An old chart-typed `FinCoverData` gives a widened
217	`AffCoverData`: reindex `Fin m₀ ⊕ Fin m₁` through `finSumFinEquiv`, the pieces are affine as
218	basic opens of the affine pinned charts, and the joint cover follows from the two chart-wise
219	covers together with `relCover_sup`.
220	
221	The point of this lemma is that widening costs nothing landed: every existing construction of
222	cover data still produces a legal widened datum.  The converse fails, and that is exactly the
223	content of R2. -/
224	noncomputable def toAffCoverData : AffCoverData C R where
225	  m := D.m₀ + D.m₁
226	  pieces := fun j => D.pieces (finSumFinEquiv.symm j)
227	  isAffineOpen := fun j => by
228	    rcases finSumFinEquiv.symm j with i | i
229	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inl]
230	      exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _
231	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inr]
232	      exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _
233	  cover := by
234	    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => ?_
235	    -- every point is in a pinned chart, and each chart is covered by its own pieces
236	    have hz : z ∈ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
237	        ⊔ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
238	      rw [relCover_sup]; trivial
239	    have key : ∃ i : D.index, z ∈ D.pieces i := by
240	      rcases Opens.mem_sup.mp hz with h | h
241	      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (D.cover₀ h)
242	        exact ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩
243	      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (D.cover₁ h)
244	        exact ⟨Sum.inr i, hi⟩
245	    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := key
246	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨finSumFinEquiv i, by
247	      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hi⟩
248	
249	@[simp]
250	lemma toAffCoverData_pieces (j : Fin (D.m₀ + D.m₁)) :
251	    D.toAffCoverData.pieces j = D.pieces (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) := rfl
252	
253	/-- The canonical chart typing of a migrated datum: chart-0 pieces are basic opens of `V₀`,
254	chart-1 pieces of `V₁`. -/
255	noncomputable def toChartTyping : ChartTyping C R π D.toAffCoverData where
256	  side := fun j => (finSumFinEquiv.symm j).isRight
257	  piece_le := fun j => by
258	    rw [toAffCoverData_pieces]
259	    rcases h : finSumFinEquiv.symm j with i | i
260	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inl]
261	      exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.h₀ i)
262	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inr]
263	      exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.h₁ i)
264	
265	end FinCoverData
266	
267	end AlgebraicGeometry

commit 820e326671a6002e13eacb65ea98f02e0df4c3b1
Author: Archon Horizon <archon@archon-horizon.local>
Date:   Tue Jul 28 16:28:55 2026 +0800

    Record the trivial witness IN THE TREE, as this file's acceptance test
    
    symPowDataTrivial (SymPowInterface.lean). ajc-pic0av hit the same defect
    independently in the same window -- PicScheme.ClassDegree has one field,
    Nonempty (... ->+ Z), satisfied by the ZERO map, and had been documented as 'the
    one remaining input to the degree map'. Two instances make it a pattern, and their
    sharpening of my formulation is the better one: an interface reduces something only
    when it asserts a NONTRIVIAL property, and the failure mode READS AS PROGRESS -- a
    named input appears, prose says 'one input remains', nobody re-measures.
    
    So rather than leave 'the bare structure is trivially inhabited' as a remark in a
    docstring, the witness is now a checked declaration: carrier := C^n, proj := identity,
    desc degenerating to 'exists-unique u, id >> u = h'. It exists to be contrastive and
    says so -- if a future lemma over SymPowData can be instantiated at
    symPowDataTrivial, that lemma is vacuous and the bug is in the lemma.

    NON-VACUITY measured at a synthesis site: the collapse fires at an actual AJC curve bundle
    
    Summary: **The trap-(d) check, and it took three attempts — which is the finding.** `ChartFinitenessRefuted` carries `[IsConstantField k X]` and `[Algebra k X.functionField]`, both produced only by SCOPED instances in `Adelic/GateInstances.lean`, so it is exactly the shape §6e catches. (1) With an arbitrary `Algebra k K(C)` supplied by hand, `IsConstantField` does NOT synthesise — the producer needs the scoped `functionFieldAlgebra` specifically. (2) With the scope opened but `GateInstances` not imported, the algebra itself fails. (3) With both, `not_chart_finite_of_primeDivisor k hU P` elaborates at an AJC curve with only `[IsIntegral] [IsLocallyNoetherian] [IsRegularInCodimensionOne]`.
    Summary: So the collapse is not vacuous: it fires at the object the lane runs on. And a consumer that forgets the import or the `open` sees a failure indistinguishable from genuine un-instantiability — the open-sensitivity §6e says no axiom line shows.
